faq.q: What's included in AV integration services?
a: Design, installation, and programming of audio-visual systems: interactive displays, digital signage, immersive installations, access control, visitor tracking, and central management. We handle the full stack: hardware, software, networking, and support.

faq.q: Can you integrate with existing museum systems?
a: Yes. We integrate with legacy AV, building management systems, visitor databases, and ticketing platforms. Our modular approach allows phased deployment without disrupting current operations.
Yes. 24/7 monitoring, preventive maintenance, remote troubleshooting, and on-site support. Our service model ensures uptime and visitor experience continuity.
